Hero.title: I design systems. I build interfaces.
Hero.subtitle: Frontend developer with 6+ years building products in React — from architecture down to every reusable component. I now use AI tools to go from idea to screen in record time.

About.label: Profile
About.heading: 6+ years turning ideas into working screens.
About.paragraph1: I'm a frontend developer specialized in React, CSS and JavaScript. I focus on building dynamic, optimized digital experiences with clean, scalable code — and on bringing AI tools into both development and screen design to speed up my workflow.
About.paragraph2: I'm organized, self-taught and problem-solving oriented. I enjoy working on ambitious projects with positive teams, exploring both frontend and backend to deliver complete solutions.

Projects.label: Projects
Projects.heading: A few products I worked on end to end.

sellers.title: Universo de Sellers
sellers.description: B2B platform for the internal team and sellers to manage onboarding and integration across multiple marketplaces. As the sole frontend developer, I structured it from scratch using the container-view pattern, and designed its screens with AI support.

componentLibrary.title: Component library
componentLibrary.description: Component system built from scratch with Storybook and CSS Modules, adopted across every application in the company.

colegioAbogados.title: Colegio de Abogados de La Plata
colegioAbogados.description: Full frontend development of the Colegio de Abogados de La Plata application, as sole frontend developer, using Refine, Ant Design and Styled Components. Worked closely with backend to define data flows and architecture.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: Platform, the application that centralizes user access to Increase's products. Designed intuitive, responsive interfaces with a focus on accessibility and user experience.

avenida.description: Sole frontend developer for Universo de Sellers. Structured the application from scratch, made product decisions, and designed screens with AI support.

dynamicus.description: Full frontend development across multiple web applications, working closely with the backend team.

henry.description: Implemented key features and built the company's component library from scratch.

increase.description: Maintained the main user-facing platform and continuously improved the product experience.
